subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker until both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths are proven fixed, or should the auth-stack dependency path be split into a separate canonical issue now?
rationale: The open sanitizer PR covers only one fix slice, while the remaining dependency/auth-stack path touches provider auth and dependency policy where automation should not choose the long-term fix shape alone.

options.title: Keep One Canonical Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until the sanitizer fix and native Vertex ADC/gaxios path both have live proof or a clear maintainer override.

options.title: Split Auth-Stack Follow-Up
options.body: Move the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure into a focused canonical follow-up and close this issue only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Accept Sanitizer Proof Only
options.body: A provider owner can accept source-level sanitizer proof while explicitly preserving the separate ADC reproduction somewhere durable.

recommendation.title: Keep One Canonical Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the sanitizer fix and native Vertex ADC/gaxios path both have live proof or a clear maintainer override.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses SDK helper ownership, provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and close/split triage for the canonical issue.
